result.instructions: Tools for Fundraise Up, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which campaigns are live right now, and how much has each raised?"; "List the donations from the last 7 days with their campaign and designation."; "Show the recurring plans that were cancelled this month and their reasons.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fundraise Up data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fundraiseup_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fundraiseup_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fundraiseup_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fundraiseup_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (name, status, type, currency, designations, frequencies). Filter by parent or subaccount id, or by designation. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/campaigns.

ending_before.description: Cursor: return records newer than this object id (previous page).

created_after.description: Only records created at or after this date-time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z).

created_before.description: Only records created before this date-time (ISO 8601).

account.description: Account id to filter by (8 characters, e.g. from fundraiseup_list_subaccounts).

designation.description: Designation id (E + 7 characters) to filter campaigns by.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its settings, content blocks, media, designations and frequencies. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/campaigns/{id}.

campaign_id.description: The campaign (FUN + 8 characters, from fundraiseup_list_campaigns) id.
